versions.changelog:
Initial release – panoramic analysis of Garmin Connect training data with dark-themed HTML reports.

- Pulls activities, per-kilometer splits, daily recovery (HRV, resting HR, sleep, Body Battery), and load balance (ACWR, Form, readiness).
- Integrates Open-Meteo historical weather and device-measured conditions.
- Five analysis engines: technique breakdown, heart rate zone distribution, heat acclimatization, training status & race prediction, body composition & energy.
- Provides concise command-line scripts and .env-based credentials for easy setup.
- Strict data handling and field validation for accuracy (including units, split sources, and field names).
- Outputs reports for period-based (weekly, monthly) or focused activity review.
